text:
Maya: FYI postmortem is up — recurring tail-latency on model-serving during peak windows. Need follow-ups on SLO changes and dashboards.
Keegan: saw it, skimmed. what's the proposed SLO change?
Maya: brief: p95 currently 180ms, p99 420ms. incidents show p99 spikes to ~1.6s intermittently -> suggests we either lower p99 target, add a higher-tier target for burst tolerance, or tighten routing to avoid overloaded GPUs.
Elena: +1 to adding a burst SL0 lane instead of moving p99. we should keep customer-facing SLOs stable.
Samir: agree. Also we need to track error-budget burn pattern across weekdays. ops-bot showed sustained burn on Tue/Thu 17:00-19:00.
ops-bot: ALERT: error_budget_burn rate=0.42 over 24h, window=2h. Recent alerts: 3 in last 7d. Link: https://console.redwood/slo/rlink
Dave: Can we get a short proposal + owners? I'm happy to own dashboard updates.
Maya: proposed action items: 1) Add a burst SLI (p999 windowed) and separate dashboard panels — owner: Dave — due: 2026-04-28. 2) Update routing policy to fall back to quantized-variant on high queue depth — owner: Keegan — due: 2026-04-24. 3) Run a 2-week canary with adjusted batching thresholds on Dedicated pools — owner: Samir — due: 2026-05-10. 4) Postmortem follow-up doc with acceptance criteria for SLO roll (if any) — owner: Elena — due: 2026-04-30.
Keegan: small nit: for #2 we should add throttling guard at p95 throttle threshold, not just fallback. I'll include config snippet.
Keegan: ```yaml
routing: 
  fallback_policy: quantized-variant
  throttles:
    p95_queue_ms: 100
    max_inflight_per_gpu: 32
```
Elena: Dave — can you add panels for: p95, p99, p999-burst, error-budget burn rate by weekday, and queue depth heatmap? link to current dash: https://grafana.redwood/d/serving/slo
Dave: yep will add. i'll also annotate the recent incidents on the dash with postmortem link.
Samir: for canary, propose exact test plan: mimic peak traffic w/ synthetic clients for 3x baseline for 48h, capture kv-cache hit rates and latencies. I'll attach plan to the follow-up doc.
Maya: thanks. quick sync: we should not change customer SLA yet. we'll use burst SLI + routing/guard rails first, monitor for 2 weeks, then revisit.
Keegan: assigning PR to add throttles + fallback rule to serving-config repo. I'll tag @ops for review.
Elena: also add alerting: when p99 > 800ms for 30m AND error-budget burn > 20% in 24h -> page eng-oncall.
ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window on 2026-04-25 02:00-03:00 UTC (informational).
Maya: Great. To confirm owners + deadlines: Dave(dashboard) 2026-04-28, Keegan(routing+throttle) 2026-04-24, Samir(canary+plan) 2026-05-10, Elena(follow-up doc) 2026-04-30. I'll create action tracker and ping owners daily until closed.
Keegan: I'll start the PR today.
Dave: dashboard PR by EOD tomorrow.
Samir: canary infra reservations requested.
Elena: doc skeleton up by EOD Friday.
Maya: thanks team. I'll close the loop in next all-hands and add SLO adj notes to the incident timeline. :thumbsup:
